blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea—North Korea dismissed a UN atomic watchdog resolution that renewed demands to halt nuclear activities, state media reported Saturday. It said the resolution has “no effect” because Pyongyang is not a member of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
